Defence Ministry body approves ₹1.10 lakh crore acquisition proposals

The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) has cleared defence acquisition proposals valued at ₹1.10 lakh crore. Approximately 98% of these procurements are designated for the domestic industry. The approvals cover proposals for all three services: Army, Navy, and Air Force.
